title: Workflow Map — CMA Part 1 Certification Pipeline Architecture
pipeline_description: The certification pipeline has evolved from the 7-gate CAQS §8.1 model into a multi-board, multi-wave architecture with 6 operational boards overseeing 8 distinct gates. Gates 0 and 6/7 were split from CAQS §8.1's model; the 300/800-series introduced Readiness, Learner Safety, QA, Launch, and Governance Boards.

gates.name: Pre-Audit Selection / Duplicate Prevention
gates.caqs_origin: Implied by §9.1 pipeline — Batch Review Process §9.2. Formalized as Gate 0 in 300-series (S318).
gates.trigger: Section or item batch enters the certification pipeline. Triggered by authoring completion (S311-S312) or post-governance-cleanup (S803).
inputs: QID list of candidate items
Pack file source (target file for insertion)
Existing MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md
DUPLICATE_PREVENTION_REPORT (previous run)
QUESTION_SIMILARITY_LEDGER (previous run)
review_agents: Validator (automated duplicate scan)
Duplicate Prevention Agent (manual collision review — e.g., S318 Agent J/AA)
Registry Sync Agent (cross-registry verification — e.g., S318 Agent K)
outputs: Collision-check report (0 collisions = PASS)
Candidate inventory (unique QIDs confirmed)
Updated MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY (Rule 3 compliance — generated, not hand-edited)
DUPLICATE_PREVENTION_REPORT (regenerated)
decisions: PASS: 0 duplicate QIDs, all candidates unique — proceed to Gate 1
REJECT: Duplicate QID found — item withdrawn, QID reassigned
defect_classes_caught: Duplicate QID across packs
Registry collision (QID already exists in another section)
G-NEW-3 dual-block verification failure (metadata ChoiceA-D ≠ content Choices.A-D)

S803 Pre-Flight: All 5 packs at 500 QIDs confirmed; no collisions on clone archivals

gates.name: Technical Review / Draft Completeness (Technical Board)
gates.caqs_origin: CAQS §8.1 G1 — 'Technical Review'. Minimum score: 90/100 rubric. Checked By: Accountant. Description: Accounting accuracy, standard references, numerical integrity.
gates.trigger: Item passes Gate 0. All mandatory fields must be present and complete (Draft Completeness).
inputs: Full question object (Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrongA-D, Metadata)
Authoritative accounting standards (ASC, COSO, IFRS, IMA CSO)
FORMULA_MASTER.md (for calculation items)
review_agents: Accountant Agent (per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md — final authority on accounting)
Technical Accuracy Auditor (e.g., S318 Agent D)
Conditional Verification Scanner (automated: DL-008/026/013/010)
outputs: Technical accuracy report (per-item: 0 conceptual errors, 0 terminology errors, 0 CMA misalignment)
Answer-key verification report (stored CorrectChoice matches independently derived answer)
Draft completeness report (all mandatory fields present)
DL-008 scan result (ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty)
DL-010 scan result (EW text must be choice-specific, not misassigned)
DL-013 scan result (no template boilerplate in EW fields)
DL-026 scan result (no empty non-CC ExplanationWrong slots)
decisions: PASS: All fields complete, 0 accounting errors, all DL structural scans clean — proceed to Gate 2
FAIL: Accounting error (wrong answer, wrong standard, wrong formula) — REJECT item, return to author
NEEDS FIX: Structural defect (DL-008/010/013/026) — route to remediation; do not certify until cleared
defect_classes_caught: DL-001: Imprecise wording causing mathematical inconsistency
DL-008: Non-empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice]
DL-010: Misassigned choice explanations (EW text describes wrong choice)
DL-013: Template boilerplate distractor explanations
DL-026: Empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots
DL-009: Incorrect ASC authority citation
DL-030: CorrectChoice answer-key errors (stored CC ≠ independently derived answer)
Conceptual errors (wrong accounting principle, misapplied standard)
Terminology errors (non-standard or incorrect technical terms)
G-NEW-2: ExplanationWrong topic mismatch (EW text belongs to different question/topic)
G-NEW-3: Dual-block Choice mismatch (metadata ≠ content block)

gates.name: Psychometric Review (DCS — Difficulty Calibration Standard)
gates.caqs_origin: CAQS §8.1 G2 — 'Psychometric Review'. Minimum score: 90/100 rubric. Checked By: Psychometrician. Description: Difficulty, Bloom's, distractor quality, bias check.
gates.trigger: Item passes Gate 1 (fields complete, technically accurate).
inputs: Technical review report from Gate 1
Question metadata: Difficulty, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, LOSTag
TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md (permitted enumeration values)
CAQS §6.1 Target Difficulty Distribution (Easy 15%, Mod-Easy 20%, Mod 30%, Diff 25%, Very Diff 10%)
CAQS §6.2 Bloom's Taxonomy Distribution (Remember 5%, Understand 15%, Apply 40%, Analyze 25%, Evaluate 15%)
CAQS §6.3-6.6: Distractor performance, cueing/bias checks, guessability criteria
review_agents: Psychometrician Agent (per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md — final authority on difficulty and exam quality)
Difficulty Specialist (e.g., S700 Layer 2 — identified systematic DL-031)
Difficulty Calibration Validator (automated: definition-match detection, DCS compliance)
outputs: DCS compliance report (% of items within ±1 of correct difficulty tier)
Difficulty/CL alignment report (each item's difficulty tier matches Bloom's level expectation)
Distractor quality assessment (plausibility, distinctness, trap coverage)
Cueing/bias check report (grammatical, length, position, absolute-language, logical-subset)
Answer position balance report (22-28% per A/B/C/D position; no streaks >4)
decisions: ALIGN: Difficulty and CL match expected values per CAQS §6.1-6.2 — proceed to Gate 3
RECALIBRATE: Misalignment detected (e.g., DL-031 definition-match inflation) — adjust difficulty label and re-run
REJECT: Severe misalignment (e.g., Easy item labeled Very Difficult, or CL mismatch beyond ±2 tiers) — return to author
defect_classes_caught: DL-031: Definition-match difficulty inflation (stem=textbook definition, answer=defined term; systematically labeled Moderate instead of Easy; estimated ~500 items)
DL-032: Case bank uniform difficulty (all 420 case items labeled Moderate — zero variance, zero calibration)
DL-004: Ambiguity (vague qualifiers: 'usually', 'normally', 'generally')
DL-003: Absolute language ('always', 'never', 'must' in distractors without standard justification)
DL-005: Distractor similarity (Jaccard >70% between distractor pairs)
Position bias (answer distribution >28% or <22% per slot)
Grammatical/length cueing
Pattern cueing (running same-answer streaks >4)
session_examples: S700 Layer 2 Difficulty Specialist: Found systematic DL-031 — 6 of 7 miscalibrations were definition-match pattern
S700 Layer 1 Case Files Scan: Found DL-032 — all 420 case items labeled 'Moderate'
S723 calibration_score: 87/100. DCS compliance 92.6%. 174 severe misalignments triggered deduction.

gates.name: Numerical Validation
gates.caqs_origin: CAQS §8.1 G3 — 'Numerical Validation'. 100% accuracy required. Checked By: Validator. Description: Independent recalculation, rounding check, tolerance check.
gates.trigger: Item passes Gate 2 AND is a calculation item (CalculationRequired=true). Conceptual items skip this gate.
inputs: Question stem (fact pattern, numbers, time periods)
Exhibit data (if exhibits are referenced)
Stored Correct answer value (not read until independent calculation complete per CAQS §5.1)
CAQS §5.2 Rounding Policy (dollars→whole, %→XX.XX%, ratios→X.XX, per-unit→4dp interim/2dp final)
CAQS §5.3 Accepted Tolerance (±$1 for dollars, ±0.01% for percentages, ±0.01 for ratios)
CAQS §5.4 Formula Verification Checklist
CAQS §5.5 Financial Statement Impact Verification (for JE/FS questions)
review_agents: Validator Agent (automated recalculation engine)
Accountant Agent (independent manual recalculation per CAQS §5.1 — solve without looking at stored answer first)
Independent Verifier (second calculation by a different agent for Gold Standard items per §14.4)
outputs: Independent recalculation result (formula → substituted values → computed result)
Comparison vs. stored Correct value (within tolerance? Y/N)
Rounding compliance report
Formula verification report (correct formula selected, all inputs trace to exhibits, units consistent)
decisions: VERIFIED: Independent result matches stored answer within tolerance — proceed to Gate 4
ERROR: Result differs from stored answer beyond tolerance — flag as potential DL-030, escalate to Accountant for answer-key correction
N/A: Not a calculation item (CalculationRequired=false) — gate automatically passed
defect_classes_caught: DL-030: CorrectChoice answer-key error (stored answer ≠ independently computed answer)
Arithmetic errors (wrong operation, wrong order of operations)
Formula selection errors (wrong formula for the tested concept)
Input errors (wrong numbers from exhibits, wrong time periods)
Rounding errors (rounded at wrong step, wrong precision)
Unit errors (mixing thousands and singles, annual vs. monthly rates)
Tax-effect application errors (applied at wrong stage)
Non-cash item errors (depreciation treated as cash outflow, etc.)

gates.name: Instructional Review / EQS (Explanation Quality Standard)
gates.caqs_origin: CAQS §8.1 G4 — 'Instructional Review'. Minimum score: 90/100 rubric. Checked By: Editor. Description: Explanation quality, writing clarity, educational value.
gates.trigger: Item passes Gates 1-3. All ExplanationCorrect and ExplanationWrong fields must be substantive and choice-specific.
inputs: All ExplanationWrong[A-D] fields
ExplanationCorrect field
Content-block Choices.{A,B,C,D} (authoritative learner-facing content per G-NEW-1)
EXPLANATION_STYLE_GUIDE.md
CAQS §4.1 Required Elements (concept identification, solution steps, business interpretation, exam trap)
CAQS §4.2 Explanation Templates (calculation item correct/detractor, conceptual item correct/detractor)
CAQS §4.3 Language Rules (professional tone, no uncertainty, choice-specific, ≥50 chars)
CAQS §4.4 Explanation Validation Rules (EV1–EV8)
CAQS §11.2 Learning Science Elements (retrieval practice, error correction, worked examples)
G-NEW-2 (Explanation Relevance — no cross-item contamination)
G-NEW-4 (Case explanation sufficiency — one-sentence explanations blocked)
review_agents: Editor Agent (per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md — final authority on language and readability)
EW Integrity Auditor (e.g., S318 Agent M — automated slot-by-slot scan)
EQS Scorer (UIQS computation)
Learning Science Auditor (LS1–LS5 validation)
outputs: EW integrity report: per-item per-slot assessment (DL-008/026/021/013/010/027)
EQS score (0-100): composite of EC quality + EW quality + learning science compliance
UIQS score (Unified Item Quality Score): aggregate of all quality dimensions, used for cross-pack benchmarking
EW character stats: per-slot length (min, max, mean, median), % below 50-char minimum
Boilerplate detection report: % of EW slots containing template text
Citation coverage: % of items citing ASC/COSO/GAAP/IMA in ExplanationCorrect
Learning science compliance (LS1-LS5 pass/fail)
decisions: SUBSTANTIVE: All EW slots filled with choice-specific text ≥50 chars, 0 boilerplate, 0 topic mismatch, all learning science elements present — proceed to Gate 5
ENRICH: EW slots present but quality below threshold (short, generic, or missing learning science elements) — flag for editorial enhancement; may certify with warning if all structural gates pass
REWRITE: EW slots empty (DL-021), boilerplate (DL-013), misassigned (DL-010), or wrong-topic (G-NEW-2) — BLOCK certification until rewritten
defect_classes_caught: DL-007/DL-013: Template boilerplate distractor explanations ('represents a plausible misconception...')
DL-021: Absent distractor ExplanationWrong fields (Pack E Section C — 95 items with no distractor EW)
DL-025/DL-026: Empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots
DL-027: Closing-tag boilerplate ('...may misunderstand how the governing standard applies...')
G-NEW-2: ExplanationWrong topic mismatch (EW text describes a completely different question/topic)
G-NEW-4: Case explanation insufficiency (one-sentence explanations at Apply/Analyze/Evaluate levels)
EV1: Explanation <50 characters
EV2: Placeholder phrases ('This is the correct choice', 'Plausible distractor')
EV3: Missing accounting principle reference in correct answer explanation
EV7: Uncertain language ('I think', 'probably', 'maybe')
LS1-LS5: Missing learning science elements

gates.name: Metadata Review
gates.caqs_origin: CAQS §8.1 G5 — 'Metadata Review'. Pass all checks required. Checked By: Validator. Description: All required fields present and valid.
inputs: Full item metadata (all fields per QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md Parts 1-4)
TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md (permitted enumeration values)
EXAM_BLUEPRINT.md (blueprint domain and LOS mapping)
QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §5 Validation Rules (field-level, cross-field, exhibit data consumption, cognitive progression)

Metadata Auditor (manual: blueprint alignment, cognitive progression verification)
Blueprint Coverage Agent (LOS mapping verification per domain)
outputs: Metadata completeness report: % of required fields present
Field-type validation report: no type mismatches
Cross-reference validation: all dependencies resolve, all formula/trap references valid
Taxonomy compliance report: all enumeration values in TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md
Blueprint alignment report: item maps to specific IMA CSO LOS
Cognitive progression report (case items: Apply → Analyze → Evaluate → Understand → Synthesize)
Metadata quality score (Dimension 10: 0-10 scale per CAQS §2.2)

INCOMPLETE: Missing required fields — route to metadata enrichment before certification
WARN: Non-blocking gaps (e.g., DL-015 cosmetic topic numbering shift) — certify with note

Field type mismatches (DifficultyScore as string instead of integer)
Invalid enumeration values (CognitiveLevel not in TAXONOMY_REGISTRY)
Blueprint misalignment (item maps to wrong domain or LOS)

inputs: All gate reports (G0-G5) consolidated into evidence package
Target pack file (original state, pre-modification)
Governance guard plugin (.opencode/plugins/governance-guard.js)
ExplanationValidator (scripts/validators/)
Validator suite (all modules)
AGENTS.md rules (batch cap: ≤30 items, backup protocol)
G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 enforcement rules (QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4)
BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md
review_agents: Validator Agent (automated: full validator suite execution)
Governance Guard (automated: 5/6 rules, 27 tests)
Certification Auditor (manual: governance gate verification per S726 specs)
Independent Verifier (AGENTS.md §5: cross-check all claims against raw file/line evidence)
outputs: Validator suite result: 0 errors, 0 new warnings

gates.name: Certification Board (DQS + UIQS + G-NEW Gate)
gates.caqs_origin: CAQS §8.1 G7 — 'Approval'. All gates pass required. Checked By: Release Manager. Description: Final sign-off for production.
gates.trigger: All items in a batch have passed Gates 0-6. Evidence packages complete. Certification Board convenes for final review.
inputs: All 7 gate reports (G0-G7) consolidated per item
Per-item evidence packages (technical review, EQS/UIQS scores, DCS compliance, EW integrity, learner safety)
DQS score (Difficulty Quality Standard): difficulty calibration per CAQS §6.1-6.2
UIQS score (Unified Item Quality Score): aggregate across all dimensions
Portfolio impact analysis (certified count change, learner pool exposure, domain coverage)
MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY (current state, before certification)
REVISION_HISTORY.md (ready for append)
review_agents: Certification Board (multi-agent panel: Accountant + Editor + Psychometrician + Validator + Release Manager per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md)
Board Chair (coordinates per-item vote, documents dissent)
Release Manager (final sign-off authority per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md override rules)
UIQS Computation Agent (cross-checks score derivation)
DQS Auditor (difficulty distribution impact analysis)
outputs: Per-item verdict: CERTIFY / HOLD / ESCALATE (with rationale for each)
Certification Board Results report (e.g., SESSION313_CERTIFICATION_BOARD_RESULTS.json)
Board vote tally: unanimous/majority with dissenting opinion documented
Portfolio Impact Analysis (certified count change, domain E/F coverage impact)
ProductionStatus promotion: 'Draft'/'In Audit' → 'Production'
question_state transition: 'Unprocessed'/'In Audit' → 'Certified'
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry (per governance-guard Rule 1)
MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md regeneration (per governance-guard Rule 3)
decisions: CERTIFY: All 7 gates pass, board unanimous or majority. Item promoted to question_state: 'Certified', ProductionStatus: 'Production'. Immediately eligible for learner delivery pool.
HOLD: One or more board members identify issues not caught by automated gates. Item held back for specific remediation. Does not enter learner pool.
ESCALATE: Critical defect discovered during board review (e.g., DL-030 answer-key error, G-NEW-2 topic contamination). Blocked from learner pool. Sent to TIER 1 structural repair.
defect_classes_caught: Any undetected defect that passed automated gates but fails expert human/content review
G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 compliance failures (final human verification)
Cross-item consistency issues (items within a rotation group or section that work individually but not together)
Bluepint coverage gaps (certification of items that leave unintended LOS gaps)
Difficulty distribution imbalance (too many Easy items certified in a single batch)
Learner-safety edge cases (items technically correct but potentially misleading)

boards_identified.also_known_as: Launch Board (S802), Pre-Flight Board (S803), Start-Up Assessment (S318)
boards_identified.description: Pre-execution gate that assesses whether an entire certification wave, batch, or section is ready to proceed. Issues launch authorization or blocks with conditions.
boards_identified.trigger: Before any certification execution wave begins. Before any pack-file write is authorized.
inputs: Portfolio health snapshot (certified count, defect status, archived/unprocessed counts)
Current baseline hashes (CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1 — all 13 runtime-critical files)
Governance guard status (all rules active, all tests PASS)
Defect inventory (open DL-008, DL-026, DL-021, DL-030, DL-016 counts)
Batch plan (item count, pack targets, state transitions proposed)
Risk register (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW items)
Predecessor session closeout reports
Ownership matrix (all required roles accepted per Principle 2)
review_agents: Readiness Board Panel (typically 3-5 agents: Startup Governance + Portfolio Auditor + Risk Assessor)
Launch Board Agent (e.g., S802 Agent Y — issues SESSION CLEARED verdict)
Dashboard Compilation Agent (e.g., S318 Agent I/R — unified session dashboard)
outputs: Readiness verdict: READY / CONDITIONAL READY / BLOCKED
Conditions list (if CONDITIONAL: specific prerequisites that must be met before launch)
Batch authorization: QID list, per-batch scope, per-batch target state
Risk acknowledgment: known risks accepted for this wave
Clear conditions: what must be true post-execution for the wave to be considered complete
decisions: READY — NO CONDITIONS: All prerequisites met. Wave authorized for immediate execution.
CONDITIONAL READY: Prerequisites outstanding. Wave authorized but execution gated on conditions being met first (e.g., 'S803 must not launch until G-NEW operationalized').
BLOCKED: Critical blocker unresolved (e.g., DL-030 answer-key error in learner pool, DL-029 methodology compromising scan accuracy). Wave must not launch.

boards_identified.trigger: After certification wave completion. Before any new Certified items enter the active learner pool. Also triggered post-fix to verify remediated items.
inputs: Full item objects for all items proposed as Certified or in the delivery pool
ExplanationCorrect and ExplanationWrong[A-D] field content
CorrectChoice value
DL-008 scan results (non-empty EW[CC] = learner sees wrong-answer text for correct answer)
DL-030 scan results (wrong answer key → learner is told wrong answer is correct)
Topic-relevance cross-check (does EW text belong to this item's topic?)
Defect manifest: known-defective QID list from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md and governance/delivery_blocklist.js
review_agents: Learner Safety Auditor (e.g., S318 Agent E — per-item safety dimensions check)
Safety Board Agent (e.g., S801 Agent G — cross-item safety verdict)
Delivery Pool Filter Agent (ensures only question_state: 'Certified' items are delivered)
outputs: Safety verdict: ALL_SAFE / CONDITIONAL / UNSAFE

UNSAFE: Critical learner-safety risk (DL-030 wrong answer, DL-008 EW misfire, G-NEW-2 topic contamination). Items BLOCKED from learner pool until remediated.

boards_identified.also_known_as: Wave Authorization Board (S802 Agent Y), Certification Execution Authorization

inputs: Readiness Board verdict (READY/CONDITIONAL/BLOCKED)

Batch plan: per-batch QID lists, per-batch target state changes, per-batch write authorization
Backup protocol confirmation (target files, backup paths, pre-write verification)

Batch Planner Agent (e.g., S802 Agent K — wave compression, session count estimation)

outputs: SESSION CLEARED verdict (e.g., 'S803 CLEARED')

boards_identified.description: Specialized board for archival operations (clone removal, seed preservation, QID retirement). Ensures blueprint coverage is preserved when items are removed from the active pool.
boards_identified.trigger: When clone redundancy is identified (DL-012) and archival action is proposed. Before any items transition from any state to 'Archived'.
inputs: Clone group analysis: stem similarity >90% after removing proper nouns, identical distractor explanations, answer-letter rotation
Seed identification: which item in each clone group is the unique seed to preserve

decisions: ARCHIVE: Clone identified, seed preserved, blueprint coverage maintained. Move clone to question_state: 'Archived'.
RETAIN: Item is NOT a clone (unique topic, independent stem, non-template distractors). Keep in active pool.
ESCALATE: Item is ambiguous (DL-016 shift, DL-029 artifact, cross-pack confusion). Requires deeper investigation before archival decision.

review_stages_breakdown.full_sequence: Gate 0 (Pre-Audit) → Gate 1 (Technical) → Gate 2 (Psychometric/DCS) → Gate 3 (Numerical) → Gate 4 (Instructional/EQS) → Gate 5 (Metadata) → Gate 6 (Final Validation/Governance Guard) → Gate 7 (Certification Board) → QA Board → Learner Safety Board → (fork: Archival Governance Board OR Launch Board → Readiness Board → Governance Board)
review_stages_breakdown.note: Gates 0-7 are per-item. Boards are per-wave/section/pool. Boards may convene before gates (Readiness), between gates and execution (Launch), after execution (Learner Safety, QA), or as meta-governance (Governance Board).

dqs_uiqs_explanation.dqs: Difficulty Quality Standard — measures how well an item's difficulty label matches its actual cognitive demand per CAQS §6.1-6.2. Tracks severe misalignments (DL-031, DL-032).
dqs_uiqs_explanation.eqs: Explanation Quality Standard — measures the educational quality of ExplanationCorrect and ExplanationWrong fields per CAQS §4 and §11. Includes EW integrity (DL-008/026/021/013/010/027), learning science compliance (LS1-LS5), and G-NEW-2/G-NEW-4 checks.
dqs_uiqs_explanation.uiqs: Unified Item Quality Score — aggregate score across all CAQS dimensions (0-100). Used as the single cross-pack benchmarking metric. Threshold ≥88 for 300-series certification. Computed from DCS + EQS + technical accuracy + blueprint alignment + metadata completeness.
